semantic_rules: Exact existing source/export/manifest hashes bind every row.
Metadata records map existing points and behavior only. No nonexistent point/trajectory is invented.
File-level source/exchange declaration is sufficient unless a key actually conflicts.
GLB extras describing points are neutral asset-pose values; hierarchy governs moved descendants.
Connection normal is not necessarily marker local +Z. Support direction is not necessarily outward triangle normal.
A float waterline is a design datum, not solved buoyancy.
Derived LODs, variants and assemblies are not additional artistic designs.
